decision: The competitor (Williams Racing) is fined €20,000, €10,000 of which is suspended for a period of 12 months subject to there being no further breach of the above Article 5 f) during that period.
fact: Team equipment left in the Pit Lane was struck by Car 22.
offence: Breach by Williams Racing of Appendix L, Chapter IV, Article 5 f) of the International Sporting Code.
reason: The Stewards heard from the driver of Car 22 ( Yuki Tsunoda), team representatives (Williams and Alpha Tauri) and reviewed video evidence. The Williams team admitted leaving the jack unattended in the pit lane and apologised for that.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
are based solely on the relevant regulations
title: Infringement Williams Equipment In Pit Lane
